notes: Full run: 20 passed; 2 random-color cases failed. After removing global random-number mocking and allowing graphics preparation in the asynchronous opening assertion, the two targeted cases passed. Latest outcome for every scenario is passed.

Earlier frame measurements exposed first-GPU-frame starvation. A nonblocking GPU fence, duplicate-resize suppression and cooperative Worker search were added; both final platform samples refreshed 72 frames in about 1.2 seconds.
Recorded cloud samples do not establish real-device FPS, heat or long-duration stability.
